scope: Get ready for the Chrome store.

topics.title: Get ready for the Chrome store
details: The app can now link to our Chrome store add-on. The store must approve it first.
The store version is not ready to use yet. Keep your current add-on for now.
Your menus, keys, and web tools work as before.

topics.title: Keep your current browser link
details: You can keep the add-on you use now. You do not need to set it up again.
The app checks the IDs for both our test add-on and our store add-on. Other IDs cannot use this link.
